spans.s: Daure-śravas, ‘descendant of Dūreśravas,’ is the patronymic of the priest pṛthuśravas, who officiated at the snake sacrifice described in the pañcaviṃśa brāhmaṇa (xxv. 15, 3).
Daure-śruta, ‘descendant of Dūreśruta,’ is the patronymic of the priest Timirgha, who officiated at the snake sacrifice described in the pañcaviṃśa brāhmaṇa (xxv. 15, 3).
